decision.rationale: The same-operation guide explicitly shows product-list objects with links arrays. The handler adds those links consistently; closing the response schema against links is incorrect.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: Product-list and product-detail examples were separated: rest.html:37 uses links array for /products, whereas :40 shows named _links for /products/2. The latter is another operation. HTML width=200 and registration/cart statuses were rejected.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
